en.headline: 404 commits, 9 PRs and 60 issues across 18 repositories in 30 days
en.teaser: Own projects shipped nine releases and bilingual docs; most issues were filed upstream on OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
### Own skill and tooling projects

Most of the window went into sogeisetsu's own OpenCode-adjacent skills. `asset-inventory` advanced through five releases (v1.13.0, v1.13.1, v1.13.3, v1.14.0, v1.15.0), adding a registry-first host-command scan, a `broken` state marker in seven locales, skills.sh one-line install, and a release-prep script with a docs-parity gate. `meld-deepresearch` shipped v0.1.0 through v0.4.0, splitting into three cooperating skills, adding a `meld.py` CLI wrapper around the six gates, and hardening blocked-source handling so unreachable citations are labelled unknown.

`opencode-go-model-picker` reached v1.4.0 with new `discover-agents.mjs` and `snapshot-summary.mjs` scripts, proxy-aware network helpers, and clarified fallback-chain checks. `opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, released 0.1.0-rc.0 and rc.1 through trusted publishing, then cut v0.2.0 and v1.0.0.

### Profile, blog and translation work

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` carried **126 own commits plus 452 automated commits**, reworking the activity card copy into English, switching the daily report to a rolling two-hour update with a manual date input, and fixing the split totals so the numbers can no longer disagree. `sopen-translate` was built from an empty repo into an MV3 page-translation extension with a provider protocol layer, chunk splitting, circuit breaker and smoke tests, with selection translation later dropped. `myBlog` received three OpenChamber capture samples, and `opencode-agent-sandbox` collected twenty-two commits of archived knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution and Windows paths.

### Upstream reports

Work outside own repositories was mostly issue reporting. On `openchamber/openchamber` the focus was the multi-run lifecycle, missing auto-update manifests, stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md, the context panel breakdown bar, browser-capture resolution and composer model switching; several of those were closed after fixes. On `anomalyco/opencode` the reports covered MiMo-V2.6-Flash vision failing after five images, image rejection on the Go endpoint and websearch Tinyfish 400s. Smaller reports went to `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`, `vercel-labs/skills`, `OpenSenseNova` skills repos and `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`.

Four pull requests to `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` were opened and then closed, covering CRLF frontmatter validation, review-server disposal, platform-specific browser launch and eval robustness, alongside a request for OpenCode V2 compatibility. One listing PR was opened to `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills`. The window had **404 commits, 9 PRs, 60 issues and 0 reviews**, with 457 additional automated commits; no days are missing. Data for 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-01 was reconstructed via GitHub Search, so star counts are unavailable and releases cover only own repositories.

zh.headline: 30 天内在 18 个仓库提交 404 次、PR 9 个、issue 60 个
zh.teaser: 自有项目发布了九个版本并完善双语文档；大部分 issue 提给了上游的 OpenChamber 和 OpenCode。
zh.overview:
### 自有 skill 与工具项目

本窗口的大部分精力投入在 sogeisetsu 自己的 OpenCode 相关 skill 上。`asset-inventory` 连续发布五个版本（v1.13.0、v1.13.1、v1.13.3、v1.14.0、v1.15.0），新增了以注册表为先的主机命令扫描、覆盖七种语言的 broken 状态标记、skills.sh 一行安装，以及带文档一致性检查的发布准备脚本。`meld-deepresearch` 从 v0.1.0 发布到 v0.4.0，拆分为三个协作 skill，增加 `meld.py` 命令行统一封装六道校验门，并规定被拦截的来源要记为观察、无法访问的引用标为 unknown。

`opencode-go-model-picker` 推进到 v1.4.0，新增 `discover-agents.mjs` 与 `snapshot-summary.mjs`，网络脚本支持代理，回退链检查说明更清晰。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件，提供 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，先以 rc 版本验证 trusted publishing，随后发布 v0.2.0 和 v1.0.0。

### 个人主页、博客与翻译项目

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 **126 次本人提交，另有 452 次自动提交**，活动卡片文案改为英文，日报改为每两小时滚动更新并支持手动指定日期，统计拆分口径也做了修正，避免数字对不上。`sopen-translate` 从空仓库起步，做成 MV3 页面翻译扩展，包含供应商协议层、分块切分、熔断和冒烟测试，之后移除了划词翻译。`myBlog` 只新增了三张 OpenChamber 截图样例，`opencode-agent-sandbox` 积累了 22 次提交，归档 OpenCode V2 分发、架构与 Windows 路径相关的知识笔记。

### 上游问题反馈

自有仓库之外的工作主要是提交 issue。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 上关注多轮运行的生命周期、v2.0.1 缺少自动更新清单、外部修改 AGENTS.md 后保存静默覆盖、上下文面板占比条、浏览器截图分辨率与切换模型时的思考等级等问题，其中若干已随修复关闭。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 上反馈了 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 在单次会话五张图片后读图异常、Go 端点拒绝图片以及 Tinyfish 搜索返回 400 等问题。较小的问题提给了 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`、`vercel-labs/skills`、`OpenSenseNova` 相关仓库和 `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`。

向 `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 提交的四个 PR 均已开启并关闭，涉及 CRLF 前置元数据校验、插件卸载时释放评审服务器、按平台启动浏览器和评测健壮性，另有一条 OpenCode V2 兼容性请求。向 `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` 提交了一个收录 PR。窗口总计 **404 次提交、9 个 PR、60 个 issue、0 次评审**，另有 457 次自动提交；没有缺失日期。2026-09-24 至 2026-10-01 的数据经 GitHub Search 重建，星标数不可得，release 仅覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: 先发布 v1.13.0 引入覆盖七种语言的 broken 状态标记，随后依次发布 v1.13.1、v1.13.3、v1.14.0 与 v1.15.0。
从 v0.1.0 发布到 v0.4.0，最终用 meld.py 命令行统一封装六道校验门。
v1.4.0 新增 discover-agents.mjs 和 snapshot-summary.mjs，并让网络脚本支持代理。
v1.0.0 冻结 skill_management 的接口面，此前已通过 trusted publishing 发布 rc 版本。
报告删除多轮运行会遗留 MCP 子进程并导致 git worktree remove --force 失败，该问题已关闭。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对所有图片返回 400。
开启并关闭了加强评测解析、聚合与安装健壮性的 PR。
提交收录 PR，把 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 加入 awesome-agent-skills 列表。
